acceptedUnresolved.reason: worldspawn music key of maps/slimefac.bsp, written without a file extension. S_CodecGetSound then tries 'music/sonic6.<ext>' against every registered codec in search order - wav, ogg, opus, because S_CodecInit registers them the other way round and S_CodecRegister prepends (ioq3 code/client/snd_codec.c) - and no pinned OpenArena release ships any of them, so the reference dangles upstream under every name the engine looks for; a missing track is silence, not a failure
